thread:
Avery: Hey all — I pushed changes that address the review comments on the runtime shard-handling logic and added a tiny merge-safety probe test. PTAL when you have a sec. CI passed locally but we saw an intermittent timeout in the `kv_shard_integration` test in the cloud run :eyes:

Sam: Thanks — can you TL;DR what the safety probe does? is it something that will slow down the canary?

Avery: TL;DR: the probe runs a small, no-op request path after a shard rotation to validate the routing table before allowing real traffic. It adds ~10ms on the critical path but only during the rotation window. I added the probe as an opt-in flag under `--merge-safety-probe` and enabled it for the canary config only.

Priya: Does this change require two approvers for merge? last time we added shard-safety tweaks they asked for an extra set of eyes.

Miguel: I can be a second set of eyes if needed. From a quick skim it looks low-risk. The probe is toggled in the config and defaults off in prod. :+1:

CI-bot: CI result: cloud/integration (linux, shard) — flake detected in `kv_shard_integration` (timeout). Rerun queued (build 4821).

Avery: Reran CI after bumping the test timeout and the rerun passed (build 4822). I also pushed a tiny cleanup to the test harness to reduce timing noise. Added a one-paragraph note in the PR describing why the probe is opt-in and how to enable it: `docs/ops/shard-safety.md`.

Sam: OK good. Can you paste the canary config snippet so I can verify fallback behavior?

Avery: Sure — snippet below (in PR description):
```
canary:
  safety_probe: true
  fallback_model: low-latency-variant
  probe_timeout_ms: 250
```
If the probe fails we immediately fallback to `low-latency-variant` and emit an alert. No global outage path.

Priya: That fallback sounds correct. +1 from me once Miguel signs off.

Miguel: Minor nits inline but nothing blocking. I validated the probe flow locally with a simulated rotation. LGTM.

Avery: Thanks both — addressed Miguel's nits and pushed a final squash. PTAL @Sam @Priya @Miguel — will queue for canary at 13:00 PT unless someone objects. :clock1:

Sam: Quick question — can we add a short note in the rollout checklist to remove the probe after 48h if no regressions? avoids long-term config cruft.

Avery: Good call. Added to the PR checklist and ops doc.

Priya: :thumbsup: 2nd approve from me.

Miguel: merging window okay on my side.

Avery: Great — thanks all. I'll kick the canary and post a follow-up if anything odd appears.
